review_text: We went to this place on a Sunday evening for dinner. The place inside (first floor) is quite small but includes very cute and aesthetic designs on the wall. Also, lots of tables are outside the establishment (and we stayed there) where they offer lots of food options!! We opted for the "Unli Wings" which has 8 flavors choices, worth 299. Though my favorite order of the night was the fruit tea!! 💖 Will definitely be back there soon just to order that again lol The staff were nice too and the waiter who accommodated us was really funny. Guess he's just trying to accommodate us well which my friends and I truly appreciate as introverted people 🥺 I was the one who recommended this place to them and I'm happy 'cause we had fun catching up!! I've always known about this place 'cause it's like a safe haven for fan girls like me to go 😆 (especially KPOP and PPOP fans). They usually organize cup sleeve events here and they're actually having a 'BINI' fan event on the upper floor when we were there. The place is within Roxas Market and it was nice to be back in this area again since it's been years since we last went here together. If you're around Roxas Avenue, this is one of the places I recommend for people to go and chill.✨

I've been here a couple of times due to cup-sleeve events, and I must say all of their drinks taste good. They also have finger foods available, and they also taste good. The prices for their menu items are reasonable, but I think they are a bit expensive for students like me. I wish they could include small meal orders in their menu. Idol fan groups (especially K-pop fan groups) have their own events here most of the time. I once co-organized a cupsleeve event here, and everything went smoothly since the café's manager is well accommodating. If you want to organize a cup-sleeve event for your idol group, make sure to schedule your events in advance since they tend to have tight bookings due to the numerous fan groups that want to hold their events there. Parking: There are parking spaces near the cafe but i do not know if juice cubi customers can park there. Meals: They only offer pastries and finger foods Service & Staff: Very good Ambiance: Very good
